warnings: F1 is a rectangular pile cap, not square: plan 1.65 (0.15 + 0.45 + 0.45 + 0.45 + 0.15) along the 4-pile direction by 1.20 (0.15 + 0.45 + 0.45 + 0.15) along the 3-pile direction; on the S-01 footing plan the long side runs along x at every point. width_mm = 1650, depth_mm = 1200.

F1 mat printed as two separate callouts, 18-DB12 (leader to a bar seen in section, i.e. bars running the 1.20 way, spaced across the 1.65 side) and 13-DB12 (leader to the bar drawn along the section, i.e. bars running the 1.65 way). main_bar.count is the two-way total 31 with count_printed_as '18+13'; the two directions have different bar lengths (1.20 vs 1.65 cap sides), which one count cannot carry — see note.

Thickness 0.30; below it 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.05 compacted sand; top of cap 1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม. 12 piles 'เสาเข็มหกเหลี่ยมกลวง Dia. 0.15 x 6.00 m. จำนวน 12 ต้น' at 0.45 spacing. The column C1 runs down into the cap (drawn with its ties); no separate pedestal size is printed.

Step sections ST-1 / ST-2 here are marked ST-01 / ST-02 on the S-01 plan; matched by riser (ST-1: 0.213 x 3 = 0.64 = รับแขก floor; ST-2: 0.18 x 3 = 0.54 = ระเบียง floor). Each is a cranked waist slab with DB12@0.20 m.# mesh, RB9@0.20 m. along the treads and one RB9 at every corner (bar_layers).

PS is the precast prestressed plank floor detail: planks bear at least 5 cm on the beams (0.05 printed at both ends), 5 cm topping (คอนกรีตทับหน้า หนา 5 ซม.) with RB 6 mm. @0.20 M. หรือ WIREMESH 4 MM., end L-bars RB 9 mm. @0.40 M. (0.50 x 0.25) at the edge beam and 0.25 x 0.25 bars plus L/4 top bars each side over an interior beam. The two stacked 0.05 at the right end read as topping 0.05 over a 0.05 plank edge; the plank's own depth is not otherwise printed. The 0.16 at the left end is the drop of the end bar into the edge beam.
